The Blazor Web App is complete. Here's a summary of what was created:

**Architecture: Auto (Server + WebAssembly) render mode** — pages prerender on the server for fast first load, then switch to WebAssembly so all interaction runs client-side without server round-trips. This is ideal for globally-distributed users.

**Key files created/modified:**

| Layer | File | Purpose |
|-------|------|---------|
| Server | `Models/Shipment.cs` | Shipment entity with status enum |
| Server | `Data/ShipmentDbContext.cs` | EF Core context with seed data |
| Server | `Endpoints/ShipmentEndpoints.cs` | REST API (CRUD + public tracking) |
| Client | `Models/ShipmentDto.cs` | Client-side DTO matching server model |
| Client | `Pages/Shipments.razor` | Dispatcher dashboard (auth required) — filter, status updates |
| Client | `Pages/Track.razor` | Customer tracking page (public) — search + progress bar |
| Client | `Pages/Home.razor` | Landing page with navigation cards |

**Auth:** ASP.NET Core Identity with individual accounts. The dispatcher dashboard requires login; the tracking page is public.

Run with:
```bash
cd ShipmentTracker/ShipmentTracker && dotnet run
```
